candidates.source_name: Finanční analytický úřad (FAÚ) — official site root
candidates.why_relevant: Primary Czech FIU and AML/CFT + sanctions supervisor for banks and payment institutions; the site is the hub from which all metodické pokyny, stanoviska, sanction pages, risk assessments and annual reports branch. Snowballing this root yields the whole cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the /cs/rozcestnik/ section tree plus /cs/aktuality; both cs and en trees exist (/en/...).
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + direct fetch of site root, section map extracted
queries_used: Finanční analytický úřad metodický pokyn povinné osoby AML

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Metodické pokyny (methodological guidelines index)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical numbered guidance series (MP č. 1 sanctions/TF, č. 3 beneficial owner, č. 4 STR reporting, č. 5 restrictive measures, č. 6 gambling, č. 7 PEP, č. 8 ID copying, č. 9 kontrola klienta, č. 11 risk assessment + internal rules). These directly define onboarding, KYC and monitoring system requirements for banks and payment providers, and FAÚ enforces against them in inspections.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape index page, diff the list of PDF links and their stated issue dates (MP numbers get silently re-issued, e.g. MP č. 9 dated 25.9.2025, MP č. 3 dated 25.4.2025); download PDFs and hash for change detection.
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched FAÚ legislation section and enumerated guideline PDFs
queries_used: Finanční analytický úřad metodický pokyn povinné osoby AML

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Stanoviska FAÚ (binding-in-practice opinions, by topic)
candidates.why_relevant: Topic-sorted interpretive opinions (obecná stanoviska, oznámení kontaktní osoby, identifikace klienta, kontrola klienta, vysoce rizikové třetí země, skutečný majitel, mlčenlivost, PEP, oznamování podezřelých obchodů). Faster-moving and more operationally granular than the metodické pokyny — the best early signal of shifting supervisory expectations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the nine sub-pages; track added/edited items per subtopic.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from FAÚ legislativa-a-metodika section
queries_used: FAÚ stanoviska povinné osoby

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Mezinárodní sankce (international sanctions hub)
candidates.why_relevant: FAÚ's sanctions branch: aktuálně o sankcích, sankce v ČR, legislativa a metodika, informační zdroje, plnění oznamovací povinnosti, výjimky ze sankcí, žádost o vynětí. This is the authority-side definition of screening, freezing and reporting duties for payment providers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the subsection tree; the 'aktuálně o sankcích' page is the timely-change feed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched FAÚ sanctions hub and enumerated subsections
queries_used: FAÚ mezinárodní sankce vnitrostátní sankční seznam oznamovací povinnost lhůta

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Aktuality (news / notices feed)
candidates.why_relevant: Fastest-moving FAÚ channel: new guidance announcements, high-risk third country list updates, deadline reminders (e.g. contact-person notification deadlines), sanctions notices. This is the natural trigger stream for a deadline tracker.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll daily; extract title+date+body; check whether an RSS/Atom endpoint exists (unverified).
candidates.discovered_via_method: site-root section map
queries_used: FAÚ aktuality povinné osoby

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Právní předpisy (legal acts index for AML/sanctions)
candidates.why_relevant: Curated list of the applicable legal base (AMLZ 253/2008 Sb., sanction acts 69/2006 Sb. and 1/2023 Sb., EU regulations). Serves as the authoritative mapping from 'obligation' to 'statutory provision', which anchors deadline and obligation extraction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape and resolve each referenced act to e-Sbírka / EUR-Lex identifiers.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from AML legislation query

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Výroční zprávy (annual reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Quantified supervisory activity: number and type of inspections of obliged entities (incl. banks, payment institutions, VASPs), administrative proceedings, fines, sanction-list screening findings, STR volumes. This is the single best indicator of where FAÚ enforcement pressure is heading, and it names the shared-supervision split with ČNB.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull (typically spring/summer for the prior year); parse statistics tables.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query 2
queries_used: FAÚ výroční zpráva kontroly povinných osob banky sankční seznamy

candidates.source_name: FAÚ — Hodnocení rizik / Národní hodnocení rizik (NRA) and risk-trend reports
candidates.why_relevant: National ML/TF risk assessment rounds (2nd round public version published; 3rd round in progress) plus the first proliferation-financing NRA and 'Zprávy o vývoji rizik'. NRA outputs feed directly into what FAÚ expects in an obliged entity's own hodnocení rizik under MP č. 11 — i.e. they pre-announce future inspection focus.

candidates.why_relevant: Government-level AML/CFT strategy naming planned legislative changes, supervisory priorities and timelines for the coming period — a forward-looking deadline and regulation pipeline for banks and PSPs.

candidates.why_relevant: Defines the operational reporting channel and format obliged entities must use under § 18–19 AMLZ: MoneyWeb (VPN + cooperation agreement), MoneyWeb Lite desktop client, electronic form, datová schránka. Changes here are direct integration requirements for bank/PSP compliance systems, and the reporting timing rules carry the hard deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the STR page, the elektronické aplikace page and the podatelna page for format/channel changes; do not attempt to access MoneyWeb itself (restricted, agreement + VPN required).

Tracking FAÚ without ČNB leaves half the obligation stream invisible — though it belongs primarily to a different coverage cell, the AML overlap must be linked.

candidates.why_relevant: MF is the ministry that drafts AMLZ amendments (transposition of AMLD5/AMLD6 and adaptation to the EU AML package/AMLR). MF pages carry draft bills, důvodové zprávy and consultation material before the obligations become law — the earliest reliable signal of upcoming obligations for payment institutions.

candidates.why_relevant: Practical consolidated-text and amendment-history source for AMLZ, 69/2006 Sb. and 1/2023 Sb., including hosted důvodové zprávy PDFs. candidates.source_name: MONEYVAL (Council of Europe) — Czech Republic evaluation and follow-up reports
candidates.why_relevant: Independent external assessment of Czech AML/CFT effectiveness and technical compliance. Czechia has been in enhanced follow-up since the 2018 MER, with targeted financial sanctions, virtual assets and cash couriers persistently rated partially compliant — these ratings reliably predict the next round of domestic legislative and supervisory tightening affecting banks and PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the MONEYVAL news feed and Czechia jurisdiction page for new follow-up reports (roughly annual); mirror to the FAÚ MONEYVAL page for the domestic framing.

candidates.why_relevant: Operational since 1 July 2025, AMLA issues the RTS/guidelines under the EU AML package (AMLR/AMLD6) that will progressively displace national metodické pokyny for banks and PSPs, and runs public consultations (e.g. Feb 2026 draft RTS on customer due diligence). Deadline stream for the CZ market even though the issuer is not Czech.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or API endpoint for FAÚ aktuality, metodické pokyny or sanctions notices was located during this pass. MZV's sanctions-list section does expose an .rss URL, but nothing equivalent was found on fau.gov.cz.
negative_findings.result_summary: FAÚ change-detection will likely require HTML/PDF diffing rather than feed subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deadline tracking for obliged entities depends on catching FAÚ notices quickly; without a feed the collector needs frequent polling and robust PDF hashing.

negative_findings.description: No public FAÚ register of individual inspection outcomes, sanctions decisions or fines against named obliged entities was found; enforcement appears to be disclosed only in aggregate via the annual report, and MP numbering shows gaps (no MP č. 2 or č. 10 listed on the current index).
negative_findings.result_summary: Entity-level AML enforcement history for Czech banks and payment institutions is not directly obtainable from FAÚ.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Enforcement-pressure analysis must rely on aggregate statistics plus indirect legal-press reporting; entity-level attribution should not be promised.

negative_findings.description: MoneyWeb, the primary secure STR submission channel, is accessible only after a cooperation agreement and VPN tunnel with FAÚ; MoneyWeb Lite is a distributed desktop client.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the public documentation of the reporting channel is collectable, not the channel itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any claim about reporting formats/schemas must be sourced from public documentation; do not attempt access to the application.

negative_findings.description: The Czech central inter-ministerial comment procedure portal for draft AML legislation (ODOK / VeKLEP, eklep.vlada.cz) was referenced in the seed query but was not directly located or fetched in this pass; the AMLZ amendment drafts were only observed via MF pages and secondary legal commentary.
negative_findings.result_summary: The authoritative CZ pre-legislative consultation venue for AML bills remains unconfirmed for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Consultations are an explicit run topic; missing the eKLEP/VeKLEP and Poslanecká sněmovna (psp.cz) bill-tracking layer would lose the earliest visibility on new AML obligations.

negative_findings.description: No Czech industry-side AML source (Česká bankovní asociace AML commission outputs, Czech Fintech Association, or a compliance-officer professional body) was confirmed with a specific working URL in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: The industry-response side of the FAÚ regulation stream is currently unmapped in this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Industry commentary on draft guidance often reveals implementation cost and timing friction that neither FAÚ nor ČNB publishes.

coverage_gaps.description: Official legislative pipeline sources are not yet pinned: e-Sbírka (esbirka.cz / sbirka.gov.cz) for authoritative consolidated AMLZ text and effective dates, eKLEP/VeKLEP for inter-ministerial comment procedure on AML bills, and psp.cz for parliamentary passage of AMLZ novely.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs pass on 'e-Sbírka zákon 253/2008', 'VeKLEP návrh zákona AML připomínkové řízení', 'psp.cz sněmovní tisk novela AML zákona' and register each as a direct source with concrete URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level sanctions list feeds that Czech obliged entities must screen against (EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List / FSD, EU Sanctions Map, UN Security Council consolidated list) were referenced indirectly via FAÚ 'informační zdroje' but not individually catalogued with verified URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.fau.gov.cz/cs/rozcestnik/mezinarodni-sankce/informacni-zdroje-171 and register each linked EU/UN list feed as its own candidate, noting machine-readable distribution formats.

coverage_gaps.description: Co-supervisors and adjacent AML authorities for specific obliged-entity classes were not covered: Celní správa ČR (gambling sector, co-author of MP č. 6), Česká obchodní inspekce, professional chambers (ČAK for lawyers, notarial and auditor chambers), and the Evidence skutečných majitelů register operated by the courts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a snowball pass on the co-supervision map named in FAÚ annual reports and MP č. 6, capturing each authority's AML guidance page.

coverage_gaps.description: Version history of metodické pokyny is not preserved anywhere obvious: FAÚ replaces PDFs at stable-looking asset paths and different filename patterns coexist (/assets/cs/cmsmedia/... vs /files/...), so silent re-issues can be missed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Hash and archive every guideline PDF at each poll, and cross-check against archiv.financnianalytickyurad.cz and web.archive.org snapshots to reconstruct the obligation timeline.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage on fau.gov.cz is partial and lags the Czech tree (only selected guidelines such as MP č. 9 exist in EN); several sanctions and stanoviska pages appear cs-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat cs as the authoritative language for this cell and use EN only for cross-border comparability; flag any EN-only-derived finding as potentially stale.

brief: The Czech AML/CFT and sanctions supervision landscape for banks and payment providers is anchored on a single dominant primary source, fau.gov.cz, which publishes the numbered metodické pokyny (notably č. 3 skutečný majitel, č. 4 OPO, č. 5 omezující opatření, č. 7 PEP, č. 9 kontrola klienta, č. 11 hodnocení rizik a systém vnitřních zásad), topic-sorted stanoviska, the sanctions hub with its oznamovací-povinnost pages, the national risk assessments and the annual enforcement statistics. Two structural facts shape collection: AML/CFT supervision of financial-sector obliged entities is shared between FAÚ and ČNB under § 35 AMLZ, so the ČNB AML/CFT supervisory strategy, dohledové benchmarky and RS-numbered opinions must be tracked alongside FAÚ; and the Czech national sanctions list under Act 1/2023 Sb. is owned by MZV (with a CSV distribution via data.gov.cz), not FAÚ, even though FAÚ inspects screening against it. The forward-looking obligation pipeline runs through MF ČR drafting of AMLZ novely, MONEYVAL enhanced follow-up pressure (targeted financial sanctions and virtual assets still only partially compliant), and increasingly through AMLA's EU-level RTS and consultations. Main weaknesses in this pass: no confirmed machine-readable feed on the FAÚ side, no entity-level enforcement register, and the official pre-legislative consultation venues (e-Sbírka, VeKLEP/eKLEP, psp.cz) remain to be pinned with concrete URLs.
